text:
alex.k: kicked off multi-region arch bakeoff for seqlen scaling — comparing latency/throughput for the three stack variants (llama-ish, mistral-ish, qwen-ish). results pushed to grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/seqlen-bakeoff

maya.r: awesome. which infra flavors? h100/mi250/a100? and are we doing quant4 vs fp16?

alex.k: yes H100 (APAC), MI250 (US-west), A100 (eu-central). runs: baseline fp16, quant4a (we used the new quantizer), and int8-ish profile for qwen-ish. seqlens: 512, 2048, 8192. batching at p95 request mix.

oliver.p: quick note: rope-phase drift shows up in longseq on the mistral-ish model at ~6k tokens on H100 (latency jump). seen similar before but unclear if kernel or KV layout.

jean.s: ran kernel-diff bisect on EU A100 — fallthrough to generic attention kernel at >4096 for mistral-ish. logs: ```
# kernel selection
model: mistral-ish
seq: 8192
selected_kernel: generic_attention_v2 (slow)
perf: p95 420ms -> 880ms
```

alex.k: thanks. MI250 didn't fallthrough there, it used tiled-attn optimized kernel and p95 stayed ~460ms. So kernel selector is region/hw dependent.

maya.r: CI-bench results (short summary):
- llama-ish fp16: H100 p50/p95 (32/210ms) @512, (180/920ms) @8192
- mistral-ish quant4a: MI250 p50/p95 (28/240ms) @512, (200/460ms) @8192
- qwen-ish int8: A100 p50/p95 (35/260ms) @512, (210/980ms) @8192
(plots in grafana dashboard)

ci-bot: benchmark run 2098765432 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/seqlen/2098765432/ (profiles + flamegraphs)

oliver.p: two observations: 1) KV prefix cache reduces p95 by ~15-25% for llama/mistral at longseq. 2) qwen-ish quant path still has a pathological rotor swap causing p95 spikes on A100 under medium batch sizes.

jean.s: rotor swap? can you paste snippet of the trace + kernel names?

oliver.p: pasted gist: https://gist.internal/rotor-swap-a100.txt — shows sudden cuda-memzero + kernel fallback before token 2048 in some traces.

alex.k: ok action items:
- jean: open a kernel-selector ticket to add force-tile policy for mistral-ish on A100 above 4k. (assign to eng-runtime)
- maya: schedule focused quant4a smoke on APAC H100 with ctxsplit on/off, measure p95 and correctness diffs (prompt set small-evals)
- oliver: dig into rotor swap traces on A100 for qwen-ish, try force-fallback to quant4a-generic to reproduce

jean.s: created ticket INF-4721 with logs attached. linking perf dashboard.

maya.r: quick run command I used: ```
./bench_tool --model mistral-ish --hardware h100 --quant quant4a --seq 8192 --batch 1 --out ./out.json
cat ./out.json | jq .p95
```

alex.k: one more note — throughput sizing: MI250 showed better token/sec for longseq for mistral-ish despite slightly higher p50, so for Dedicated capacity planning we should prefer MI250 pools for heavy long-context workloads.

jean.s: tagging @sre-bot for capacity planning input.

sre-bot: noted. adding MI250 longctx pool proposal to the capacity board for next week's planning meeting.

alex.k: thanks everyone. will follow up with a short writeup (inc. kernel workarounds + recommended regional-capacity splits). :thumbsup:
